standard.summary: 使用 SageAttention（量化 attention）后端时，每 N 步把 SageAttn 输出与 SDPA 参考输出对比一次，检测量化漂移。0 = 关闭（默认）。
standard.effect: 开启后训练循环内建 AttentionDriftMonitor，每 N 步做一次双后端对比；相对误差超过阈值时按 sageattn_drift_fallback 策略告警或切回 SDPA。
standard.whenToUse: 首次在新模型/新数据上启用 SageAttn，想确认 INT8 量化 attention 不会悄悄污染训练时；长训任务想要漂移兜底时设 100~500。
standard.avoidWhen: attention 后端不是 sageattn 时无意义；检测步需要额外跑一次 SDPA 参考前向，间隔太小（<50）会明显拖慢训练。

standard_en.summary: When the SageAttention (quantised attention) backend is in use, compares SageAttn's output against an SDPA reference every N steps to detect quantisation drift. 0 = off (the default).
standard_en.effect: With this on, an AttentionDriftMonitor is built into the training loop and compares the two backends every N steps; when the relative error exceeds the threshold it warns or switches back to SDPA according to sageattn_drift_fallback.
standard_en.whenToUse: The first time you enable SageAttn on a new model or new data and want to confirm INT8 quantised attention is not quietly contaminating training; set 100~500 as a drift safety net on a long run.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Meaningless when the attention backend is not sageattn; a detection step has to run an extra SDPA reference forward pass, so too small an interval (<50) slows training noticeably.

advanced.principle: SageAttention 用 INT8 量化 QK^T 换速度，个别分布下量化误差会放大。周期性与全精度 SDPA 输出对比相对误差，把「量化是否可靠」从盲信变成可观测指标。
advanced.intervention: training_loop_init_core.py：interval > 0 时实例化 attention_drift_monitor.AttentionDriftMonitor(threshold, fallback)；epoch 循环每 N 步触发对比。
advanced.expectedImpact: 检测步吞吐下降（双前向），其余步无开销；漂移事件会进日志/告警。
advanced.tradeoffs: 注意：UI 上的阈值键 sageattn_drift_check_threshold 后端实际读取的是 sageattn_drift_threshold（默认 0.01）；间隔与阈值需权衡误报率与检出率。

advanced_en.principle: SageAttention quantizes QK^T to INT8 for speed, and under some distributions the quantization error gets amplified. Periodically comparing relative error against full-precision SDPA output turns "is quantization reliable" from blind trust into an observable metric.
advanced_en.intervention: training_loop_init_core.py: when interval > 0 it instantiates attention_drift_monitor.AttentionDriftMonitor(threshold, fallback); the epoch loop triggers the comparison every N steps.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Throughput drops on check steps (double forward), other steps have no overhead; drift events go to logs/alerts.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Note: the UI's threshold key sageattn_drift_check_threshold is actually read by the backend as sageattn_drift_threshold (default 0.01); interval and threshold must trade off false-positive rate against detection rate.
